description: What is open in an East End town at this moment and until when, computed from verified opening hours against the East End's clock (America/New_York). Covers restaurants, breakfast, nightlife, wine, wellness, hair salons, ice cream, farm stands and oyster farms. `places` is ordered closing-soonest-first; each row carries `closesAt`, address, phone, source and the date last verified. `hoursUnknown` counts venues in scope whose hours the guide does not hold; they are not in `places`. `publishedHoursOnly` lists venues that publish an hours line the guide has not parsed, with that line. `opensNext` lists the venues that open soonest and when. `seasonalClosureRisk` lists venues verified as not year-round with no confirmed season dates for today; they are held out of `places` in every month because the weekly hours they leave published are the summer table, they are not reported as closed either, and each carries its phone. Venues whose operator has published a seasonal closure are omitted. Returns up to 10. Each venue row also carries `mapUrl`, a link to the guide's live map centred on that venue (hamptonsverified.com/near-me?focus=…), and the answer carries one top-level `mapUrl` for the whole list. The map asks for the reader's location on their own device; the link carries no position. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

town.description: A hamlet ('Sag Harbor', 'Montauk') or a whole region ('the Hamptons', 'the North Fork', 'the East End'), in the asker's own words; a region is answered across every hamlet in it.

name: whats_open_now
title: What's open right now
